name: Morgan Example

bullets.text: Maintained build and release pipelines for eight internal services, replacing manual handoffs with signed build artifacts and a single checklist that each service owner could run.
Created temporary test environments on AWS for feature branches and removed idle resources overnight, giving developers a repeatable environment for testing schema changes before release.
Traced delayed alerts to a queue shared by reporting and transactional jobs, separated the workers, and added a dashboard to show the age of the oldest pending message.
Designed an internal API for deployment history that connected release identifiers with incident reports and made it possible to compare failed and successful rollouts by service.
Partnered with the support team to rewrite the first-response guides for twelve recurring incidents, then used tabletop exercises to identify confusing steps and missing escalation contacts.
Piloted an internal search assistant for engineering runbooks, evaluated its answers against a set of resolved support tickets, and recorded common retrieval failures for the documentation team.
Tested database snapshots in an isolated recovery environment each month and logged restoration times and gaps in the checklist for the engineers responsible for business continuity.
Built Python utilities to summarize recurring application errors from service logs and routed the most frequent problems to the engineers responsible for those components.
Interviewed the operations team about manual reporting tasks, documented the source data behind each report, and built a shared validation checklist for end-of-month reporting.
Reconciled overnight inventory imports against the source system, traced malformed records to inconsistent timestamps, and added validation messages that helped operators diagnose rejected files.
Consolidated three intake queues into one ticket workflow and added routing rules that directed requests to the correct owner before the morning support shift.
Prepared weekly release notes from completed tickets and checked each change with its owner so support staff could identify expected behavior after deployment.
Trained new analysts to investigate incomplete records using SQL and a small set of repeatable checks, then gathered their feedback to simplify the onboarding guide.

certifications: Cloud Operations Foundations | Practical Incident Response
